newsitem.title: USA: U.S. copper rod production rises in Aug from July.
newsitem.headline: U.S. copper rod production rises in Aug from July.

text.p: U.S. copper rod production rose to 341.29 million pounds in August, up from a revised 307.7 million in July, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics said.
Rod production at rod mills in August was 280.38 million pounds, with 60.1 million pounds of rod produced at refineries.
Cathode consumption for rod production totaled 338.98 million pounds in August, up from 301.9 million pounds in July.

Copper rod inventories at rod mills in August totaled 72.42 million pounds, with a further 80.55 million pounds of rod inventory at refineries, down from 97.12 million pounds and 104.02 million pounds in July, respectively.
Total rod receipts in August were 347.67 million pounds, up from a revised 346.30 million pounds.
Total shipments of rod in August were 371.72 million pounds, up from 334.58 million pounds in July.
